description: reporting — inject the lean-reporting output contract on every prompt, re-pulse it every Nth tool call, and block a contract-violating final message at Stop (forcing a compact rewrite). Kill-switch: REPORT_GUARD_OFF=1 (silences inject, pulse, and Stop guard).

hooks.command: [ "${REPORT_GUARD_OFF:-0}" = "1" ] || cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/reporting/hooks/brevity-reminder.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠️ brevity-reminder DISARMED — contract file unreadable.'
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/reporting/hooks/contract-pulse.py" 2>/dev/null || echo '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ contract-pulse DISARMED — hook failed to execute."}'
